As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
We are looking for a motivated Web Application Developer ready to take us to the next level! If you have the ability to support the Oklahoma Department of Agriculture's Inspections application by converting existing inspection forms into web-based solutions, developing database integrations, and supporting application enhancements and are looking for your next career move, apply now. 
 Job Description 
 We are looking for a Web Application Developer to support the Oklahoma Department of Agriculture's Inspections application by converting existing inspection forms into web-based solutions, developing database integrations, and supporting application enhancements. This position will be a full-time, 9-month contract and onsite in Oklahoma City, OK .
 What You'll Do 
 Convert existing fillable PDF inspection documents into interactive HTML forms for data collection

 Develop JavaScript functionality that allows inspector-entered data to be stored in a SQL database

 Support the generation and storage of PDF documents using Jinja templates

 Develop and maintain application functionality that supports agricultural inspection workflows

 Collaborate with project stakeholders and development team members to support the replacement of the existing inspections platform

 Provide JavaScript development support to help maintain project timelines and deliverables

 Write, test, and troubleshoot application code to ensure reliable system performance

 Support database integration and data management activities

 Assist with application enhancements, defect resolution, and system improvements

 Participate in testing and validation efforts to ensure application functionality meets business requirements

 Document development processes, technical solutions, and application updates

 What You'll Need 
 Required:
 Beginner to intermediate software development experience

 Experience with JavaScript development

 Experience working with SQL databases

 Experience developing with HTML

 Experience developing with CSS

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

 Ability to learn new technologies and development tools quickly

 Strong communication and teamwork skills

 Ability to work onsite in Oklahoma City

 Preferred:
 Experience with Python

 Experience with Jinja templates

 Experience with Docker

 Experience with Git and GitHub

 Experience developing web-based business applications

 Experience supporting database-driven applications

 Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA and other federal, state and local standards

 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings, etc.

 Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor
